title: Does not fit the iPad screen
body:
This app is awesome, very friendly interface, easy to use , and it’s fun, making such music notes with every time you enter a positive date that makes me feel like playing piano tales. It’s awesome, but unfortunately , I am using it on iPad , so it somehow the app appear in the size of iPhones and the rest of screen is in black.
I think this adjustment won’t be a problem to be fixed.

Thank you for your effort for this nice app. I love it.
